prose: A short antirez post titled 'Human coders are still better than LLMs.' Only the title was captured, so this summary rests on it alone.

On that basis: Salvatore Sanfilippo argues that despite rapid LLM progress, human programmers still hold the edge - presumably on judgment, design, and the parts of coding that aren't typing. His specific arguments are unknown from the capture.
